release_policy.semantic_version_component: The final vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH segment is the app's SemVer. Namespace each app to avoid colliding version numbers in the single repository.
release_policy.initial_baseline: Use 0.1.0 only when no valid prior app SemVer exists and the app's current source commit passes the release gate.
required_gate: source branch and immutable commit known
canonical route and internal links pass
accessibility and mobile/desktop smoke test passes
release notes and rollback ref recorded
release_policy.publication_state: No formal GitHub Releases have been published. A manual gated workflow is staged in this draft PR; it requires the manifest ledger to mark an app READY_FOR_RELEASE and a verified branch SHA. Do not release blocked or fallback-built apps.
